hints.title: Even Number Property
hints.text: A number is a multiple of 2 if and only if it is even.

hints.title: Parity Check
hints.text: If n is already even, the smallest common multiple of 2 and n is n itself.

hints.title: Odd Factor Scaling
hints.text: If n is odd, the smallest multiple of both 2 and n is 2 * n.

hints.title: Parity Conditional Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct parity check and multiplication in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through multiples of 2 until reaching a multiple of n is unnecessarily slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) logic with zero additional memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Resolves parity check with ternary expression in constant time.
